title: Undo a bulk edit
description: Rewind orders to their state just before a mistaken bulk edit.
noPermission: Only SuperAdmin can use this page.
warning: Preview and run both read the data AT CLICK TIME. Any order someone changed after the incident is SKIPPED, never overwritten. At most {{max}} orders per run; every changed field is logged.

form.actorPlaceholder: Name, email or id (e.g. Admin User)

groupHelp.designer: Puts the assignee back and rebuilds the designer status and timestamps from the designer's own logs (unassigning erased them without logging).
groupHelp.tool-ok: Puts 'ok' and ready-for-production back; an order pushed out of the print queue goes back in, waiting since its original 'ok'.
groupHelp.tool-note: Puts back a removed tool note (other than 'ok').
groupHelp.tool-result: Puts the tool result back to its value before the incident.

skip.title: Skipped
skip.edited-after: Someone changed it after the incident
skip.current-differs: Current value differs from what the incident left

run.title: This batch: {{count}} / {{total}} restorable orders
run.reasonPlaceholder: Reason (required, ≥10 characters) — e.g. undo of the mistaken edit of 05/10 by Admin User
